per_pair.hand_note: Question names an award (Rookie of the Year) and a league (NBL); the SQL filters neither and dumps 10 rows ordered by year with an unnamed LIMIT 10 that truncates. No honest question-side wording makes an unfiltered 10-row dump mean that award.
'first 10 products sorted by product ID and name' names the cap and the order; projection name+price matches 'names and prices'.
COUNT(DISTINCT zip_code) over avoid filtered by bad_alias='Hon' is exactly 'unique zip codes flagged as bad aliases for Hon'.
COUNT(*) with obj_sample_id > 43 AND x < 174 matches both stated conditions; no extra filter, no cap.
COUNT(*) with reach > 98 AND day < 22 matches the question; the v1 model reason ('Ship Date', 'sales and profits') describes a different pair and is not grounded in this SQL.
